name: prompt-dialect
description: Underlines mistakes in your prompt as you type, fixes them with a click, and rewrites the prompt for the Claude model you are using.

checkAsYouType.title: Check as you type
checkAsYouType.description: Check the prompt for mistakes whenever you pause typing. /dialect on|off overrides it.

grammarModel.title: Grammar model
grammarModel.description: The model that checks the prompt: a fast, cheap one. An alias such as haiku or a full model id.

improvementModel.title: Rewrite model
improvementModel.description: The model that rewrites the prompt for the session's model when you press Improve.

debounceMs.title: Pause before checking (ms)
debounceMs.description: How long you pause typing before the prompt is checked, from 250 to 10000.
